```{r}
library(stringr)

text_data <- readLines("data/subcell.txt")

locations <- text_data[grep("^ID", text_data)]
unique_locations <- unique(trimws(str_remove(str_remove(locations, "^ID\\s*"), "\\.$")))
df_unique_locations <- data.frame(`Is a` = unique_locations)

print(df_unique_locations)
```





```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Extract valid locations as a vector
valid_locations <- tolower(trimws(df_unique_locations$`Is.a`))

# Function to clean and filter subcellular locations, and generate a vector for neural network
clean_and_filter_locations <- function(subcellular_text, valid_locations) {
  # Step 1: Clean the text
  cleaned_text <- gsub("SUBCELLULAR LOCATION: ", "", subcellular_text)  
  cleaned_text <- gsub("\\{[^\\}]*\\}", "", cleaned_text)          
  cleaned_text <- gsub("Note=.*", "", cleaned_text) 
  
  # Step 2: Normalize to lowercase and remove extra spaces
  cleaned_text <- tolower(trimws(cleaned_text))
  
  # Step 3: Split the cleaned text by both periods and commas
  location_candidates <- unlist(strsplit(cleaned_text, "[,.;]+"))
  location_candidates <- trimws(location_candidates)
  
  # Step 4: Filter out empty strings after split
  location_candidates <- location_candidates[location_candidates != ""]
  
  # Step 5: Extract unique location tokens
  unique_tokens <- unique(location_candidates)

  # Step 6: Match the unique tokens against the valid locations
  matches <- unique_tokens[unique_tokens %in% valid_locations]
  return(matches)
}

generate_location_matrix <- function(df_proteins, valid_locations) {
  # Initialize a matrix with zeros
  location_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_proteins), ncol = length(valid_locations))
  colnames(location_matrix) <- valid_locations  
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_proteins)) {
    locations <- clean_and_filter_locations(df_proteins[i, "Subcellular location [CC]"], valid_locations)
    for (loc in locations) {
      location_matrix[i, loc] <- 1  # Mark location with 1
    }
  }

  # Convert the location matrix to a data frame
  location_matrix_df <- as.data.frame(location_matrix)
  
  # Add 'Entry' and 'Sequence' columns to the data frame
  location_matrix_df <- cbind(
    Entry = df_proteins$Entry,
    Sequence = df_proteins$Sequence,
    location_matrix_df
  )
  
  # Remove columns where all values are 0 (excluding 'Entry' and 'Sequence')
  location_matrix_df <- location_matrix_df[, c(1, 2, which(colSums(location_matrix_df[, -c(1, 2)]) > 0) + 2)]
  
  return(location_matrix_df)
}

# Generate the final location matrix
location_matrix_df <- generate_location_matrix(df_proteins_filtered, valid_locations)

# View the result
head(location_matrix_df)


```



```{r}
sequence_lengths <- nchar(location_matrix_df$Sequence)

percentile_75 <- quantile(sequence_lengths, 0.75)
cat("75th Percentile Length:", percentile_75, "\n")

long_sequences <- sequence_lengths[sequence_lengths > percentile_75]
cat("Number of sequences longer than 75th percentile:", length(long_sequences), "\n")

filtered_sequences <- location_matrix_df$Sequence[nchar(location_matrix_df$Sequence) <= percentile_75]
cat("Number of sequences after filtering:", length(filtered_sequences), "\n")

location_matrix_df_filtered <- location_matrix_df[nchar(location_matrix_df$Sequence) <= percentile_75, ]
sequence_lengths <- nchar(location_matrix_df_filtered$Sequence)

head(location_matrix_df_filtered)
```

```{r}
# Define the maximum length for padding (75th percentile length used earlier)
max_length <- percentile_75  # Use the previously calculated 75th percentile variable

# Function to one-hot encode a single sequence, pad it to max_length, and flatten the matrix
one_hot_encode_and_pad_flatten <- function(sequence, max_length) {
  # Define the amino acid groups (alphabet)
  amino_acids <- c("A", "R", "N", "D", "C", "E", "Q", "G", "H", "I", "L", "K", "M", "F", "P", "S", "T", "W", "Y", "V")
  
  # Create a mapping from amino acid to index (for 1-hot encoding)
  aa_to_index <- setNames(1:length(amino_acids), amino_acids)

  # One-hot encode the sequence
  one_hot <- lapply(strsplit(sequence, "")[[1]], function(aa) {
    # Initialize a vector of zeros with length 20 (one for each amino acid)
    encoded_aa <- rep(0, length(amino_acids))
    # Set the corresponding index to 1
    encoded_aa[aa_to_index[aa]] <- 1
    return(encoded_aa)
  })
  
  # Convert the list of vectors into a matrix
  one_hot_matrix <- do.call(rbind, one_hot)

  # Pad the matrix to the right with zeros if necessary
  pad_size <- max_length - nrow(one_hot_matrix)
  if (pad_size > 0) {
    padding <- matrix(0, nrow = pad_size, ncol = length(amino_acids))
    one_hot_matrix <- rbind(one_hot_matrix, padding)
  }

  # Trim the matrix if it exceeds max_length (just in case)
  one_hot_matrix <- one_hot_matrix[1:max_length, ]

  # Flatten the one-hot matrix into a single vector (concatenate all rows)
  flattened_sequence <- as.vector(t(one_hot_matrix))  # Transpose and flatten

  return(flattened_sequence)
}
# Apply the function to all sequences in location_matrix_df_filtered
x <- do.call(rbind, lapply(location_matrix_df_filtered$Sequence, one_hot_encode_and_pad_flatten, max_length = max_length))

dim(x)  # Should be (num_sequences, max_length * 20)
```
